text: BSRP II is a €14 million initiative with continuity from Phase I, emphasizing country-owned implementation through dedicated Country Implementation Plans and national coordinators. It integrates multi-sector inclusion, focusing on finance, government, education, civil society, and vulnerable groups. The program establishes a National Multi-Hazard Early Warning Centre Coordinator in PNG and invests in digital tools training for disaster risk management.

metadata.solution_name: Building Safety and Resilience in the Pacific Phase II (BSRP II)
